brief:
After two years of bombardment and forced displacement during Israel's military campaign in Gaza, Suhaila al-Mabhouh had one wish: to return home, Middle East Eye reported. The case illustrates how Palestinians in the enclave face mounting threats not only from direct military strikes but also from the humanitarian crisis created by the blockade.

Gazans contend with shortages of food, medicine, and basic services alongside the dangers of ongoing military operations. Some who endured the bombardment have died from deprivation caused by the restrictions on movement and access to resources.
dek: Gaza: ‘She survived the bombing, but not the blockade’ After two years of bombardment and forced displacement during Israel ’s genocide in Gaza , Suhaila al-Mabhouh had one wish: to go home.
title: Gazans die from blockade after surviving Israeli bombardment
